notToBeConfusedWith.name: Scotch Whisky
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Made across the water under its own rules, usually triple-distilled and rarely peated; the two are not interchangeable where a recipe names Irish whiskey specifically.

forms.label: Standard strength
forms.sourceNote: Alcoholic beverage, distilled, all (gin, rum, vodka, whiskey) 80 proof. Public domain. FoodData Central carries no Irish-specific record; distilled spirit composition does not vary by grain or region once bottled at the same proof, and Irish whiskey is near-universally bottled at 40% ABV, so this generic 80-proof record applies unchanged.
